review_route.rationale: Forged reuse can skip current execution and falsely report CompleteExecution.

material_finding.summary: Public caller-implementable RoutineSession can return an old binding after real candidate mutation, so valid prior evidence can still produce VerifiedReuse and CompleteExecution.
material_finding.result: Real LiveContext revalidation failed after tracked mutation, while FrozenSession(old binding) returned Hit and CompleteExecution.

required_correction: use concrete LiveContext or an opaque sealed live session at every authority boundary
bind report completion to a freshly revalidated current candidate
preserve the opaque executed and reuse evidence correction
verification_gap: A reused-target full suite attempt failed ENOSPC; existing test-binary output had no captured terminal status and is not counted as proof.
highest_defensible_ceiling: The original caller-authored result/observer forgery is closed. Current-candidate verified reuse and truthful CompleteExecution remain unsupported.
no_claim_statement: No public integration, readiness, release, node closure, or goal completion is claimed.
